DATA QUALITY / STATISTICAL SIGNALS

              
Data Quality & Statistical Alerts

              
Automatically highlights unusual sales and data-quality issues in the currently filtered records. A flag is a reason to review a record—not proof of fraud.

            

            
0flags found

          

          
Checking sales data…

          

            
            
            
          

          

            

              
SeveritySale / PeriodDateProductTypeWhy it was flagged

              
Load sales to run detection.

            

          

          
—

          
Method: for product groups with at least 8 transactions, unusually high net sale values or quantities are identified using the upper Tukey fence (Q3 + 1.5 × IQR). Monthly revenue spikes use the same rule when at least 8 months contain sales. Missing/out-of-range dates and invalid amounts are also flagged. These checks use only records returned by Supabase and do not modify the database. Synthetic dates (2024–2026) can create artificial time-based patterns.
